ParaBlock.RichText: By the end of this lesson, you will be able to describe AI tools' main functionalities for information gathering (with examples) and list four steps to gathering information with an AI tool like ChatGPT.

Tabs.Instructions: Hover over each card to learn more.

Content.RichText: The act of locating relevant information from available sources efficiently
The process of condensing information into a clear and concise form
The extraction of stored information for effective use in decision-making
A degree of correctness ensuring outputs are precise and reliable
The testing and validation of AI models for accuracy, fairness, and compliance

ParaBlock.RichText:
Whether you're curious about one topic or a wide field of research data, AI can help you gather that information.
Google's search engine revolutionized the way people could find not just information, but relevant information. Now, AI tools like ChatGPT quickly organize relevant information as a direct response to your questions and requests.
In three quick steps, ChatGPT can provide detailed answers, summarize content, and offer insights on various topics:

Web.altText: Examples of prompts and responses showing how ChatGPT provides concise information, along with steps describing how a request is processed. The image contains several text elements. The top section shows two headings, Prompt and Response. The sequence follows the arrows in this order Ask ChatGPT to give you facts summarize information, or give you ideas. ChatGPT processes your request. You are given the information you have requested in a concise way. Prompt What is the most popular US travel destination Summarize data from our customer service feedback surveys, Give me store display ideas. Response New York City tops the list and is known for its iconic landmarks such as Times Square and the Statue of Liberty Seventy seven percent of customers liked online shopping, twenty percent found it just okay, and three percent disliked it Display protein bars near hiking shoes

ParaBlock.RichText: All you have to do is ask your question, and ChatGPT will give you a direct, comprehensive answer.

Topic.Title: How to gather information using AI

ParaBlock.RichText: Here are four steps to consider when gathering information using an AI tool like ChatGPT.

Web.altText: A four step process for asking questions using an AI tool. Here are four steps to consider Step one. Identify information needed and the question to be asked. Step two, Input the question into ChatGPT. Step three. Review the provided response for accuracy and to ensure it sufficiently answers the question. Step four. Ask follow up questions to gather additional details or to clarify information.

ParaBlock.RichText: No matter what your initial question is, you can ask for more (or less) information until you get the answer and the format that you're looking for.

Topic.Title: Steps to gather information with AI

ParaBlock.RichText: You've learned how AI tools like ChatGPT can help you gather information on nearly any topic that you can think of. Review the steps needed before your AI expert walkthrough.

Web.altText: A four step process for using ChatGPT, identify information, input question, review answer, and ask for more details, optional. Step one, Identify information needed. Determine the specific question or information you need, I want to learn about tree frogs in Madagascar. Step two, Input the question into ChatGPT. Type your question into ChatGPT input field and submit it, can you tell me about the tree frogs that live in Madagascar. Step three, Review the answer. Read through the response provided by ChatGPT to see if it sufficiently answers your question and to review accuracy of the information. Step four, Ask for More Details Optional. If you need more information ask follow up questions for clarity or additional details, I want to learn more about the tree frogs that live in the pandan trees there. Can you tell me more about their life cycle.

ParaBlock.RichText: When you begin your practice, don't be afraid to ask ChatGPT follow-up questions to get more clarity on its original response.
In this activity, you will use ChatGPT to help gather information on a topic of your choice. Once you’ve completed this activity, return to the lesson to share what you have learned.

Item.ItemPara: Access ChatGPT through the app or website.
Follow the four steps to gather information using ChatGPT:
Determine what you want to learn about.
Prompt ChatGPT to gather information for you.

ParaBlock.RichText: If you need ideas for topics to gather information on, try one of the following prompts:

ItemPara.Italic: Can you give me detailed information about starting a home garden, including tips for beginners?
Help me gather information on how to network with my colleagues in my company.
Can you provide information on professional development opportunities in my field, including certifications, courses, and workshops?

ParaBlock.RichText: Once you've completed the activity, take time to reflect on the following questions.

Item.ItemPara: How did ChatGPT help you gather information on your chosen topic?
What key points and details did ChatGPT highlight about your topic? How did these help you better understand the subject?
How did the ChatGPT's response to your prompt for more details enhance your understanding of the topic?

ParaBlock.RichText: You now have the skills to use ChatGPT to learn about new topics, making information gathering quick and efficient.

Item.ItemPara: Use the four steps to enhance your knowledge and improve your decision-making in both your personal and professional life.
Utilize additional prompts to clarify and deepen your understanding.
